public_rationale: The July METR paper explicitly reports that AI access increased completion time by 19% in its randomized trial. Marcus's word 'sometimes' preserves the study's limited scope. Later evidence about improved tools does not reverse what that study found.
limitations: The trial involved experienced developers working on familiar open-source projects.
The finding does not establish the average effect across all software development.
The event date refers to the July publication being assessed, not the earlier experimental work.
